messages:
sam_ops: Heads-up: EU crossdock just notified us of a 10-unit hold -> customs VAT/insurance paperwork. Affects next week's H200/H100 wave. Need remediation plan.
jia_supply: ETA on the hold? Any docs missing specifically?
carlos_vendor: Customs flagged commercial value vs invoice mismatch and missing insurance certificate for 10 H100s. AWB `CN-EU-998877`. We can either: 1) provide insurance cert + updated invoice (3 business days), 2) dispatch temporary loaners (refurb) from DE depot within 48h, or 3) air-split 4 units at expedited rate.
andre_fleet: Temporary loaners ok but must sign firmware escrow + ensure NVLink compatibility. Refurbs need burn-in logs.
logi_bot: Suggested runbook: if loaners accepted -> create LOA, update PO amendment, arrange courier pickup, tag inventory `temp-depot-eu-1729`.
sam_ops: Also ask vendor for SLA credits for lost capacity. We should negotiate deposit waiver on refurbs.
carlos_vendor: Vendor can offer 10% invoice credit for units delayed > 72h. Deposit waiver possible if we sign a 30-day loaner agreement. Refurbs are factory-refurb with full burn logs; NVLink tested but require firmware patch v3.2.1 which we must push before production.
jia_supply: Cost math please: expedite 4 units = +$3.5k/unit air + broker, loaners = deposit $1.5k/unit (refundable) + courier. Long-term replacement cost unchanged.
andre_fleet: Firmware patch window: 2-3hrs per node rolling; KV cache may need warm restart. We can do staged rollout to priority clusters.
rma_bot: RMA-90321 created for AWB CN-EU-998877, status=awaiting_docs, est_clear=2026-04-02.
sam_ops: Plan: accept 6 refurb loaners to cover critical queues, request 10% SLA credit, ask vendor to waive deposit contingent on loaner agreement + liability cap. Also start cross-region routing for non-prod: move 30% APAC batch to eu-cost-surge.
carlos_vendor: Will draft loaner agreement now. Can we confirm depot acceptance checklist: serial whitelist, firmware checksum, NVLink pairing IDs?
andre_fleet: Yes. Checklist: serial, fw version, nvlink id, burn-in log (12h), and test vector pass. Send checklist template to vendor.
logi_bot: Checklist template created: `checklist_v2.pdf` reference id `CHK-ware-1729`. Upload when vendor ready.
sam_ops: Good. Jia, run quick cost delta for canary routing vs expedited air and post by EOD. If vendor posts LOA/insurance docs drop them here. :pray:
